messages:
From: Lisa Park <lisa@helixsys.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Morris <sarah.morris@resellerco.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer details for Helix pilot

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the intro call last week. We ran an internal pricing review and have two asks before we can route the private offer through procurement:

1) Can you provide a SKU-level mapping showing how the current SKU bands in the private offer map to the unit metrics Helix will be billed for (node-hours vs reserved slot-hours)? We need this to validate our cost model.
2) Our reseller (ResellerCo) needs visibility into expected net margin by SKU after partner pass-through and any seller fees — they asked for a simple waterfall so they can confirm their commission scheduling.

We are targeting procurement approval by 8/16; is it possible to get the SKU mapping + margin sheet by EOD Wednesday (8/11)?

If it helps, Sarah from ResellerCo is copied and can chime in on format.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Park
Head of Cloud Procurement
Helix Systems

Attachment: sample_invoice_example.pdf (stub, application/pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer details for Helix pilot

Thanks Lisa — clear asks. Looping in Ben (pricing/marketplace) and Camila (partner ops) to pull the exact mappings and the partner-facing margin waterfall.

Plan:
- Ben will produce SKU mapping showing private-offer SKU -> billing unit + example invoice line (CSV/Excel).
- Camila will draft a waterfall with seller fee, reseller commission assumptions, and suggested note for procurement on pass-through handling.
- I will QC and send a single zipped package to you and Sarah by EOD Wed (8/11).

Ben/Camila — prefer the waterfall to show both (A) list-price to partner net (showing seller fee) and (B) a conservative commissioning scenario (2.5% seller fee / 12% reseller commission) + an optimistic scenario (1.5% / 15%). Helix wants clarity for procurement. Also include a one-line explanation of any rounding or bundling rules (e.g., how burst hours are aggregated).

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Director, Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer details for Helix pilot

Hi team — attaching SKU mapping (v3) and margin workback draft. Notes below.

Attachment: sku_mapping_v3.xlsx (stub, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: margin_workback_v1.pdf (stub, application/pdf)

Key assumptions I used:
- Private offer SKUs are mapped to reserved slot-hours for steady-state workloads; burst usage billed by node-hour lines with a 1.25x uplift to reflect on-demand pricing differential.
- We left a "conversion factor" column so Helix can substitute their observed burst ratio.
- Seller fee default = 2.5% (can be overridden by us per deal).

Camila — I flagged two SKUs in the Excel where list-price rounding changes the reseller net by +/-0.4%. Recommendation: we present both exact and rounded waterfall in procurement materials to avoid surprise during invoice reconciliation.

Lisa / Sarah — please review the attached and let us know if you prefer a different commission assumption for the waterfall. Happy to run a quick call to walk the sheet.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Principal, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Summary of what's attached:
- sku_mapping_v3.xlsx: SKU mapping, conversion factors, example invoice lines.
- margin_workback_v1.pdf: Partner waterfall with three scenarios (base/optimistic/conservative).

Ask from Helix procurement: if they want specific proof of previous pass-through timing (invoice samples showing reseller payout cadence), please confirm and we can provide redacted examples. Naomi (cc'd) owns billing operations and can produce the redacted invoice thread if needed for procurement evidence.

Next steps:
- Lisa: confirm if the 2.5% seller fee and 12% reseller commission baseline are acceptable for procurement review. If yes, we will push the private offer to Draft in Marketplace and share the HubSpot record.
- Sarah: confirm whether ResellerCo needs the waterfall in Excel (editable) or if the PDF suffices for your procurement team.

Thanks all — happy to hop on a 20-min call today if that speeds approval.

Best,
Hannah
